stem_md: 曲线 $x^2+y^2=R^2,z^2+y^2=R^2$ 在点 $(\frac R{\sqrt2},\frac R{\sqrt2},\frac R{\sqrt2})$ 处的法平面方程是。
analysis_md:
设 $F(x,y,z)=x^2+y^2-R^2,\ G(x,y,z)=z^2+y^2-R^2$，

得
$$
F_x\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=2x\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=\sqrt{2}R,
$$
$$
F_y\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=2y\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=\sqrt{2}R,
$$
$$
F_z\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}=0,
$$
$$
G_x\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}=0,
$$
$$
G_y\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=2y\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=\sqrt{2}R,
$$
$$
G_z\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=2z\bigg|_{\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)}
=\sqrt{2}R,
$$
$$
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(y,z)}=2R^2,\quad
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(z,x)}=-2R^2,\quad
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(x,y)}=2R^2,
$$
则法平面方程为：
$$
2R^2\left(x-\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)-2R^2\left(y-\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)
+2R^2\left(z-\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}\right)=0,
$$
整理得：
$$
x-y+z=\frac{R}{\sqrt{2}}.
$$
